description: Standardize API response envelopes and pagination across all 15 microservices. Create a shared `@rawdrive/shared-api` package with: (1) Standard error response envelope matching `ErrorResponse` schema in backend, (2) Unified pagination response type using `PaginatedResponse[T]` generic from webhooks-service as standard, (3) Success response wrapper ensuring consistent `{data, meta, status}` structure. Currently services implement pagination inconsistently: some use `{items, total, page, has_next}` while others use `{data, meta}` with different field names.
